description: The guide's icon in the Suunto app's guide list is a blue-violet gradient with a barbell. Pushes a resistance-training guide to the user's Suunto account via the SuuntoPlus Guide Cloud API — the tool to use for gym sessions. Step titles show where you are: a prep step is '<i>/<N>' (exercise i of N), a set step '<i>/<N> - <k>/<S>' (exercise i of N, set k of S), and a rest '<i>/<N> REST'; with lapGranularity 'perExercise' the work step is '<i>/<N>'. Set popups read 'SET k/S' with '<name> - <detail>'; the last set of an exercise pops 'LAST SET' with 'Next: <next exercise>' (or its own name and detail for the final exercise); perExercise keeps 'GO'. Text lines are cut to the watch's 40 characters by shortening the exercise name; the weight/plates line is capped at 36 characters so the name keeps at least 3. (Titles and popups are not part of the lap labels; a shortened name is, and compare_workout_to_plan matches such a name to the plan by prefix.) The guide's list description names the day's exercises ('Bench · Row · ...', cut at 60 characters). Per exercise: a prep step (self-paced stopwatch showing the plate breakdown if given, otherwise the weight/sets detail, plus the exercise name and live HR; a lap press starts the exercise), then with lapGranularity 'perSet' (default) each set is its own step ended by a lap press, and each rest between sets is its own step showing 'Next: set k/S' (plus, when the exercise sets restTargetHr, a heart-rate gauge up to that bpm). restMode 'countdown' (default) counts down restSec and auto-advances into the next set with a vibration; 'stopwatch' counts up and waits for a lap press. lapGranularity 'perExercise' gives one step per exercise after its prep, with no between-set rests and no per-set laps. Every prep, set and rest is its own lap and the guide ends with one extra 'Session complete' step, so a perSet session records 2 × (total sets) + 1 laps. Read them back after the workout with get_workout_laps — its labels are the step texts. Requires SUUNTO_APP_NAME to exactly match the app name registered on apizone.suunto.com. Without guideId a new guide is created on every call (see list_guides / delete_guide to tidy up); with guideId that guide is overwritten. There is no live push to the watch: it appears after the phone's next normal Suunto app sync. Returns Suunto's response (including the guide id) plus nextStep and check: { verified, note? }: after the push the guide is looked up in the guide list (by id), and verified:false with a note means the push went through but the guide was not found there — say so to the user instead of reporting success. Pushes are queued one at a time with a short pause, so several calls at once are safe. How the step titles and popups look on a real watch is not yet verified on a device. Write operation.

detail.description: Display string shown on the exercise's set steps, and on the prep screen before it unless 'plates' is given — include weight and sets, e.g. '60kg 3x10'.

last.description: Optional: what was done last time, e.g. '3x8@60kg' (get_exercise_history's suggestion.last). Shown with target in a 'TODAY' popup when the exercise's prep step starts, never in the step text, so lap labels are unchanged. The hint 'Last <last> > <target>' must fit 36 characters: when it does not, last is shortened to its top reps ('10/10/10/10/8@102.5kg' becomes '10@102.5kg'), then dropped so the target stays whole, and if even that does not fit there is no popup (a number is never cut). Not yet verified on a real watch how the popup renders.

plates.description: Per-side plate breakdown for barbell exercises, e.g. '2x20+1x5/side' — shown on the prep screen instead of detail, since that's when the bar actually gets loaded. Omit for non-barbell exercises (dumbbell, machine, bodyweight, cable); compute the math yourself before calling this tool, it isn't done here.

restSec.description: Rest between sets within this exercise, in seconds. With restMode 'countdown' (default) it's the countdown and auto-advance duration; with 'stopwatch' it's shown as a target label only. Not applied between exercises — that's the self-paced prep stopwatch.

restTargetHr.description: Optional target heart rate to recover to during this exercise's rests between sets, in bpm (41-200). Adds a gauge from 40 to this value right after the live HR on every rest step of this exercise (both restModes); it is a visual target only and does not end the rest. Not shown on prep or set steps. Omit for no gauge.

sets.description: Number of sets for this exercise.

target.description: Optional: today's target, e.g. '3x8@62.5kg' (get_exercise_history's suggestion.target). See last.

guideId.description: If provided, updates this existing guide instead of creating a new one.

lapGranularity.description: 'perSet' (default, recommended): one step per set plus one per rest, so laps bound every set/rest individually — needed to read per-set HR and duration from the synced workout. 'perExercise': one step per whole exercise instead, like push_workout_guide — shorter Guide list, coarser data.

restMode.description: Rest between sets. 'countdown' (default): counts down from restSec and auto-advances into the next set. 'stopwatch': counts up and waits for a lap press — the user paces it. Has no effect with lapGranularity 'perExercise' (no between-set rests). Before/between exercises is always a self-paced stopwatch.

title.description: Short session name shown in the Suunto app, e.g. 'Push A'.
